WITH budget_totals AS (
  SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) as total_cost, COUNT(*) as expense_count
  FROM expense
  GROUP BY link_to_budget
),
avg_spend AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_cost) as average_spend
  FROM budget_totals
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT bt.link_to_budget, bt.total_cost, bt.expense_count, avg_spend.average_spend
  FROM budget_totals bt
  CROSS JOIN avg_spend
  WHERE bt.total_cost > avg_spend.average_spend
)
SELECT 
  AVG(aa.total_cost) as average_total,
  SUM(aa.expense_count) as total_expenses,
  AVG(aa.total_cost - aa.average_spend) as average_excess
FROM above_average aa
